summary: Page pe Urdu/Arabic reels bohat achi chal rahi hain, especially mobile phone shop, jewellery aur bakery videos. English reels aur picture posts ka performance bahut low hai, unko kam karo. Agla haftha sirf high‑score business types aur zabardast hooks ke sath reels aur long videos post karo, aur har post pe WhatsApp CTA zaroor daalo.

tips: Start each reel with a bold, benefit‑driven hook like “Apka Business 3x Faster Grow Karega” especially in Urdu and Arabic where engagement is highest.
Showcase high‑performing business types – mobile phone shops, jewellery, cafes and bakeries – and mention specific outcomes (e.g., more customers, sales boost).
Use Arabic and Urdu titles that promise a quick upgrade (“ارتقِ بمتجرك”, “Web Builder کے ساتھ بزنس کو آگے بڑھائیں”) and keep English titles simple and action‑oriented (“Supercharge Your Business”).
End every video with a clear CTA to WhatsApp the business for a free demo, avoiding any price mention.
Avoid static picture posts and English‑only reels for school, travel or restaurant niches, as they have the lowest scores.
